author: Fairly shy
text_post: If I reply to a thread, and take a little time to think out what I want to say, all too often, I press the submit button, and a message pops up telling me that someone else has posted since I started, and do I still want to post.  This seems damn silly, and more than once (like just now) I have not noticed this in time, and just moved on and lost my contribution. The more thought out a response is, the more likely it is to get lost this way! FS

author: tylo
text_post: This happens to me sometimes. I thinks it good because you can add something to address the last post before submitting. Or change it a little bit if the new post gives you a new idea that you would like to add.  I never lost anything because of this. Just scroll down and submit again and it should post.

author: MrToad
text_post: Also, before you hit post, hit ctrl+A, then ctrl+C! Or if you're in a mac.... umm, whatever, just select all the text you typed, and copy it. Just in case the board flakes out on you and you lose what you typed.
